creating: The rule appears in the draft once it has a condition or a rule set: without conditions it would take all traffic.

unknown.title: Form unavailable for this rule
unknown.description: Edit this rule on the JSON tab. Edits to other rules leave its JSON unchanged.

formlessAction: The form does not support the “{{action}}” action. Edit the rule on the JSON tab.

conditions.unknown: This rule’s conditions are only visible in JSON.
conditions.empty: No conditions: the rule takes all traffic, and the rules below never fire.
conditions.group: Conditions are joined with “{{mode}}” in nested rules. Edit them on the JSON tab.
conditions.inverted: The condition is inverted: the rule fires when it does not hold.
